capabilities: Apply one of 14 built-in visual themes to the graph view
Animate nodes with glow effects in random, wave, rainbow, pulse, or static modes
Customize wire color, thickness, glow, and sag
Adjust node size, glow, and text color
extras: Not yet available through the Community Plugins directory; the README lists manual installation as the only current option and notes a pending community release. Desktop only. A donation link is included.
intentEvidence: A beautiful animated Graph View plugin for Obsidian with glowing themed nodes
problem: Obsidian's built-in Graph View has plain static styling with no options for glow, animation, or decorative visual effects.
summary: Graph View decoration plugin that adds glowing animated nodes, curved garland-style wires, and 14 decorative themes.
